title: Failed forced-check actions (e.g. 'drag the skiff free', 'talk him into leaving') raise their own DC by 1 per miss with no in-fiction alternative offered, which can spiral a stat-mismatched build (Scholar's low might/grace) toward a near-unwinnable grind on an optional but plot-relevant action.
where: Fenmarch Ironbound Mission skiff / Hollowbrook Robbed Mounds
